title: Road Escort
description: Ride alongside a Concord merchant's caravan through a stretch of road known for trouble.

title: The Bandit Camp
description: Locate and break up a bandit camp that's been preying on grain shipments.

title: Smugglers' Evidence
description: Recover a ledger proving an Outlaw smuggling ring has been bribing a city's toll-keepers.

title: Rooting Out Corruption
description: A city guard captain is on the take. Gather proof before he covers his tracks.

title: The Warlord's Reckoning
description: Vrakthar the Unbound has united the wildland tribes and means to sack the trade roads city by city. The Enforcers are marching on his stronghold, and they want you at the front.

title: Quiet Cargo
description: Move a wagon of untaxed goods past an Enforcer checkpoint without drawing attention.

title: Fence the Goods
description: Offload a cart of "recovered" cargo through a fence who won't ask where it came from.

title: Raid the Rivals
description: Hit a rival caravan's supply run before it reaches an Enforcer-contracted buyer.

title: Jailbreak
description: An Outlaw courier got picked up by the Enforcers. Get her out before she talks.

title: Before the Forging's Done
description: The Enforcers commissioned the Order of the Arcane to build a war construct to crush Outlaw activity for good. It isn't finished being empowered yet — this is the only window to stop it.

title: First Contract
description: A simple combat contract: clear a stretch of road, collect your pay, no questions.

title: Guard for Hire
description: A merchant needs muscle for a single dangerous leg of their route. Standard rate.

title: The Big Contract
description: A high-paying job, this time for the Enforcers. The guild doesn't care who's buying.

title: No Questions Asked
description: Another high-paying job, this time for the Outlaws. Same rule applies.

title: The Challenger's Due
description: Kestra Vane, champion of a rival company, has called you out by name to settle who really runs the contract board. No politics, no escorts — just the duel.

title: The Lost Artifact
description: Recover a minor arcane relic before it falls into careless hands.

title: Escort the Archivist
description: A traveling archivist needs safe passage between two Order chapterhouses.

title: Ruins of Something Older
description: Strange lights have been reported over a set of ruins nobody's fully mapped. Investigate.

title: Contain the Outbreak
description: A minor magical outbreak is spreading through a village's water supply. Contain it before it spreads further.

title: What Threnval Wakes
description: Reckless treasure hunters disturbed something ancient in the deep wilds. Threnval, the Ashen Wyrm, is waking, and the Order needs it contained before it fully does.
